LZA-G-ACT-1: Management Account: Central governance and management of all accounts in the environment; Root account
LZA-G-ACT-2: LogArchive Account: Centralized ingesting and archiving of all logging and backups for all accounts in the environment
LZA-G-ACT-3: Audit Account: Security Tooling Account for operating AWS Security Services
LZA-G-ACT-4: Network Account: Hosting network infrastructure that acts as a gateway between your application and the Internet
LZA-G-ACT-5: Shared Services Account: Hosting centralized IT applications utilized by resources in the environment
LZA-G-ACT-6: Perimeter Account: Hosting Internet-facing IaaS based ingress/egress security services
LZA-G-ACT-7: Deployment Account: Hosting resources required for orchestrating installation of the Universal Configuration
